selection_rule.individual_AP: Highest DEV_VAL AP among LOGISTIC_REGRESSION, RANDOM_FOREST, LIGHTGBM; ties use NON_HGB_ORDER.
selection_rule.individual_ROC: Highest DEV_VAL ROC-AUC among the same candidates; include separately only if different; ties use NON_HGB_ORDER.
selection_rule.delta_direction: selected benchmark or ensemble minus HGB
